stories.title: The "tragedy of the cognitive commons" explains how rational AI adoption could destroy entire professions' expertise
stories.summary: A new research paper frames AI adoption as a "tragedy of the cognitive commons." Every company that cuts entry-level jobs benefits individually, but the collective expertise of entire professions erodes.
